# Cinematic Training I

**LEVEL 1 \- Pantomime**

## **🎭 Less is more… (Part 1\)**

* The shot will be based on **a theme** that will be decided by the team lead  
* The duration should be within **5 \~ 7 seconds**  
* **You are required to use one character only**  
* The camera does not need to be fancy (a static camera is fine and dandy)  
* **Body language is the main focus for this level** (secondary movements is not a priority & facial expressions are not unnecessary)


**❗❗ Keep in mind of the camera as it will affect Part 2 ❗❗**

## **😲 …but more is perhaps better (Part 2\)**

* Using what you have created in Part 1, turn it up a notch by **adjusting the camera to convey the emotion for the scene**  
* Make use of the focal length to enhance the overall atmosphere\!
